decisions.question: q-21063

authoring.question: q-21063
authoring.value:
To find the image of the triangle under the action of $T$, we first create a matrix $X$ containing all of the vertices of the triangle:

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, we compute the image of $X$ under the action of $T$ by calculating the matrix product $TX:$

$$
\begin{aligned}TX & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}6 & 8 & 10 \\ 3 & 4 & 5\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coordinates of the image's vertices are $(6,3)$, $(8,4)$ and $(10,5).$ Notice that all three points lie on the same line.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14040372/assets/a91af151d3dc0e48aef0eef58012f6c9f72aaff02aafae2d55fe0714c29c96e3.png)

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

Now, we compute the image of $X$ under the action of $\mathbf T$ by calculating the matrix product $TX\mathbin{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}TX & =[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 \\ -6 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 1 & -2 \\ -6 & -2 & 4\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coordinates of the image's vertices are $(3,-6), (1,-2),$ and $(-2,4).$  Notice that all three points lie on the same line.
